ns2:course.label: Plant Proteomics
ns2:course.description: Broad introduction to plant proteomics, including a survey of contemporary methods and their applications for protein identification and the study of posttranslational modifications and protein-protein interactions. These topics will be studied in relation to the proteomes of organs and subcellular compartments, stress, nutrition, and signal transduction. Same as CPSC 468. Prerequisite: MCB 354; IB 472; or consent of instructor.
